nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context ignore list that keeps git metadata, secrets, virtualenvs, local Chroma and report data, caches, tests, and scratch notes out of the analyst image.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the Ouroboros conversation runtime on port 8765 and the Streamlit analyst dashboard on port 8000, sharing named volumes for Chroma, reports, forecast cache, and news cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Analyst waits on an HTTP healthcheck of Ouroboros; tini (init: true) keeps worker process custody from treating Docker PID 1 as an orphan.

nodes.name: ouroboros
nodes.summary: Compose service that builds docker/ouroboros.Dockerfile, binds DeepSeek-compatible model settings, and exposes the internal API on 8765 with persistent /data volumes.

nodes.name: analyst
nodes.summary: Compose service that builds the root Dockerfile, publishes Streamlit on 8000, bind-mounts oil_gas_analyst for live code, and starts only after Ouroboros is healthy.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Python 3.11-slim image for the Streamlit dashboard adapter: installs requirements-analyst.txt, copies config, samples, and oil_gas_analyst, and runs dashboard.py on port 8000 without Torch or Hugging Face weights.
nodes.languageNotes: Default OUROBOROS_URL points at the compose service hostname ouroboros:8765; embeddings default to OpenRouter.

nodes.name: python
nodes.summary: python:3.11-slim build stage that installs analyst dependencies, sets Chroma/samples/reports/news-cache paths, and launches Streamlit on 0.0.0.0:8000.
